name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.30: the fridge lighting panel, and the legacy 0-10 LED control removed in the same build so there is never a window with neither. Controls tab on a fridge now carries mode off/on/schedule, a daytime level, an optional night window with its own level and times, and the shopping wake - plus three instant test buttons that send set_led so the wiring can be proved without waiting for a config poll. Values are read from the machine's own configPreview rather than a local copy, so what is shown is what the machine will actually be served. The panel states the level that should apply right now, computed in the night window's OWN timezone rather than the browser's, which is routinely a different one when someone checks from abroad; the wrap-past-midnight case is handled explicitly and verified at every boundary (21:59 day, 22:00 night, 07:59 night, 08:00 day). An unsupported answer from set_led is shown as such rather than leaving three buttons that quietly do nothing - the kiosk app has not implemented ctlLed or ledBrightnessAdjustment yet, so unsupported is the expected answer until it does. The old LED brightness field on Display Settings is gone from the markup, its reader and writer, the settings allowlist, validateSettings and both machine-creation literals: it was 0-10, never reached any machine, and would have been a second scale to drift against the operator-facing 0-100. hasLedStrips stays as a hardware-presence flag and its DEFAULT_SETTINGS value is now true, matching the two creation paths it previously disagreed with. Cumulative over v6.29.
